intake.title: Draft with AI
intake.description: Paste a customer's message (email, chat or call notes) and add up to 3 photos. AI drafts the job below; you check every field before saving.

unavailable.disabled: AI drafting is turned off for this organization. An owner or admin can turn it on in Settings → AI.
unavailable.not_configured: AI drafting isn't configured on this server. Fill in the form below.
unavailable.quota: This month's AI quota is used up. Fill in the form below, or ask an owner to raise the quota.

intake.messagePlaceholder: e.g. "Hi, the AC in our bedroom is dripping water since this morning. It's Maria at 12 Elm St, 512-555-0187."
intake.photoUnreadable: Couldn't read {name}. Try a JPEG or PNG.
intake.quota: {used} of {limit} AI drafts used this month
intake.refused: AI declined to draft this message. Fill in the form below.
intake.failed: AI couldn't draft this message right now. Fill in the form below.
intake.applied: The AI draft is in the form below. Check each field, especially the ones marked for checking, then create the job.
intake.checklist: Add these checks to the job's checklist

review.title: Needs review
review.description: A customer sent this request through the portal. Compare the AI's suggestions with the request, apply the ones you agree with, then confirm.
review.drafting: A customer sent this request through the portal. AI is drafting it.
review.draftingHint: The draft appears here in a few seconds. You can confirm the request without it.
review.failed: A customer sent this request through the portal. AI couldn't draft it; check the request and confirm it.
review.skipped: A customer sent this request through the portal. AI drafting was off; check the request and confirm it.
review.nothingToApply: The AI agrees with the request as it is. Confirm it to move it into the queue.
review.noDraft: A customer sent this request through the portal. Check it and confirm it.
review.applySelected: Apply {count, plural, =0 {selected} one {# suggestion} other {# suggestions}}
review.applied: {count, plural, one {# suggestion} other {# suggestions}} applied

timeline.confirmedApplied: confirmed the request with AI suggestions: {fields}

settings.title: AI features
settings.description: AI drafts jobs from customers' messages and portal requests. People confirm every change; nothing is saved by the AI alone.
settings.notConfiguredHint: This server has no Anthropic API key, so AI drafting is unavailable whatever you choose here. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the server's environment to turn it on.
settings.enabledHint: Smart intake on the new job form and drafts for portal requests. Turn it off and every form works by hand.
settings.quotaHint: AI calls per calendar month (UTC) for the whole organization. 0 stops AI until next month.
settings.invalidQuota: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100,000

usage.title: This month
usage.description: Every AI call is logged with its tokens, latency and what the dispatcher did with the draft.
usage.outcomes: {accepted} saved as drafted, {edited} saved with edits, {discarded} discarded, {failed} without a draft, {open} not decided yet.
